title: Robert Jameson's targeting team called in to restart Oscar Flight missiles

tellings.quote: I got a call saying a missile went off alert in Oscar flight.

plain: In 1967, at Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana, a team led by a man named Robert Jameson, whose job was setting the missiles' targets, is said to have been called in to restart the nuclear missiles of Oscar Flight, a group of launch sites that had stopped working. A former Air Force officer named Robert Salas tells Michels what Jameson told him: "I got a call saying a missile went off alert in Oscar flight." Salas tells it as part of his account of a UFO shutting down nuclear missiles, which, if true, would mean something unknown could switch off America's nuclear weapons.
